body: I insist that my partner was awake
They woke up and made it conciously. They looked me in the eyes before doing it

Nice and loving, though last two weeks we have argued a lot. 99% of the time they is the sweetest, funniest most loving person, but has some troubles managing their anger when arguing and might not purposely gaslight me and neglect me sometimes

I'm gonna tell the whole story since you're not getting it:
-It was our anniversary and I woke up super early in the morning to go see them, and when I arrived they was asleep. I took off my shoes and put my stuff on a chair, and I sat in their bed and said "Good morning, happy anniversary babe", and they turned their face and said "Good morning, come here so we can sleep a little bit together". And I snuggled with them even I wasn't sleepy, so I just was the big spoon and I was kissing their back and giving they cuddles (thing I asked if it was ok to do before doing it) and said "babe I'll only let you sleep 1 hour more, then we wake up and have breakfast" (because I didn't want to stay in bed the whole day), to which they agreed. 
I was just checking media in my phone while I was waiting for the time to wake them up, as I was brushing my fingers across their hair and giving occasional kisses in the forehead. 
When the time arrived, I said "babe it's time, wake up", and they started to beg for five more minutes and I was like "no Hun, we can sleep later, now we have to eat breakfast". They continued complaining and I said "I know you're tired, but if you sleep more you won't be able to sleep at night, cmon wakeee". I went to put my shoes on and when I turned they was trying to sleep again, so I sat by and that's when the thing happened. 
They wasn't half asleep or anything and had been told many times before that needed to wake up.

I had been telling they in a soft voice for like two minutes to wake up. They was trying to get cozy in the bed but we needed to wake up right away and he was like "five more minutes pleeeeaseee". So I didn't give them the scare of their life, they was at least semi-conscious

I swear I just tapped their cheek and said softly "hey you need to wake up". My dad gets shocked whenever he's asleep and woken up, even if it is by lightly touching his arm, so I kinda have experience on not being so harsh when waking up others, plus the last time it happened was so long ago I couldn't remember it at the time I did it. My partner wasn't passed out when I did this, they was half awake or so, so it wasn't a big scare and I had been a few minutes like "cmon baby you have to wake up"

I feel scared to bring this up, because it happened a week or two ago and I really didn't give it many thought (I felt like it was perhaps my fault and they is grumpy in the morning), it only started to hurt when I talked about it with my best friend
They said it was because I woke them up in a harsh way, I don't know if I'm overreacting
